statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The symptoms occur intermittently and must be correlated with arrhythmic events over an extended period
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is clinically indicated
The service is supported by the documented diagnosis of R00.2
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
